{{Top|leg}}
An [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] '''Huntmaster missile''' was a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]] that could be deployed anywhere in mere minutes. It was the missile that was used on the attack on [[Hadde Base]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] army base in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hadde]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was extremely fast, and capable of intercepting almost any [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
